title: Why Calibrate a Pricing Model? From Many Possible Prices to Market Fit
utility_use_case: A scientist comparing two measurement columns can export a labeled scatter plot for a report, or plot one variable’s distribution to spot unusual values and data-entry problems. In a pricing-model workflow, this kind of exploratory check helps review market observations before calibration. The figure is descriptive only: it does not estimate significance, establish causality, or validate a model.
